title: Check a Palindrome
question: Check whether text is a palindrome, ignoring spaces and letter case.
code:
text = input("Text: ").lower()
cleaned = "".join(char for char in text if char.isalnum())
print("Palindrome" if cleaned == cleaned[::-1] else "Not a palindrome")
expected_output:
For input Never odd or even:
Text: Never odd or even
Palindrome
explanation: The program removes non-alphanumeric characters and compares the text with its reverse.
